executionArgs.additionalInstruction: This is a Python 3.11 FastAPI backend project. Use pytest with FastAPI TestClient. The project uses uv (not pip) for package management - run tests with 'uv run pytest'. The database uses SQLAlchemy with SQLite. Mock external services (AWS Bedrock, Datadog, GitHub API, Minimax API) - do not make real API calls. The app is in rule_viewer/main.py with the FastAPI app object. Use the existing test fixtures in tests/conftest.py if applicable. Write comprehensive tests targeting 100% coverage of all API endpoints in rule_viewer/api/routes.py. Do NOT open a browser or Chrome.
